create_ModelAccelNPG: create a ModelAccelNPG instance with a learned WorldModel and planning parameters
run_train_step: run a training step with N trajectories using learned dynamics models and policy rollout
move_to_device: move all learned models and baseline network to a specified CUDA or CPU device
check_cuda_status: check if any learned model or baseline network is running on GPU
get_action: get an action from the policy or refined action based on the refine flag
